ResearcherNotesUnit: Second FSRU to be added alongside the existing Ertuğrul Gazi at BOTAŞ's Dörtyol FSRU terminal (Hatay), announced by Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar on 2026-02-01. Stated to add ~28 million cubic metres/day of regasification, matching the existing vessel and doubling terminal output to ~56 mcm/day. Capacity 5.70 MTPA is INFERRED (yellow) from parity with the existing Dörtyol unit (GEM has Dörtyol at 5.70 MTPA for the same 28 mcm/day Ertuğrul Gazi) — sources state mcm/day, not MTPA. The ~28 mcm/day basis is corroborated by three independent non-GEM outlets (Daily Sabah, Hürriyet Daily News, Türkiye Today); the MTPA conversion itself is the GEM inference (yellow). Concrete step: engineering work reported ongoing (turkiyetoday); Daily Sabah phrases it as 'in a process of planning and working.' No charter/vessel named, no FID, no in-service target year. Expansion of an EXISTING GEM terminal -> staged as a new UNIT, not a new terminal. confidence_per_field set: yellow on inferred/implied fields.
